requireCanonicalPathReferences.description: When a skill, rule, or adapter restates a topic owned in docs/OWNERS.yaml, it must cite the canonical path and must not exceed maxNonCanonicalSummaryLines of restated body.

allowedNewDocProcedure: Search existing docs for the topic and title
If canonical exists: edit that path only
If new topic: add OWNERS.yaml entry, then create exactly one file at the registered path
Do not create secondary overviews, agent notes, or parallel trees
correctiveMessage: Docs ownership violation for mivia: docs/OWNERS.yaml is the source of truth for topic ownership. Update the existing canonical document; do not create parallel or duplicate docs, unregistered paths, or forbidden title/path patterns. Register new topics in docs/OWNERS.yaml before adding a file. Cross-link the canonical path instead of copying content.
